video_title: Keeping a home with a large family
evidence: SponsorRadar's current Farmhouse on Boone sponsorship record identifies BOROUX as the sponsor of the English-language YouTube video 'Keeping a home with a large family' published July 31, 2026. Farmhouse on Boone has about 740K subscribers and the video has roughly 137K views. BOROUX sells tangible home water-filtration products. BOROUX's official Collaborations page actively recruits social-media influencers through Shopify Collabs and Impact, provides dedicated affiliate support, and explicitly lists McCall Knecht at mccall@boroux.com for questions about its affiliate programs and partnership opportunities.
